performance_case.causal_mechanism: Aroon14 distinguishes the relative recency of complete-day highs and lows without averaging price, scaling directional movement by volatility or using a trailing stop before the next-open decision.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for exact Aroon14 oscillator thresholds negative 25, zero and positive 25. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, tune any formula or gate, substitute a neighbor, create Trading behavior, activate a strategy or open OOS unless every frozen gate passes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The policy is valuable only if it reduces adverse exposure enough to meet strict drawdown and Calmar gates without sacrificing required upside, hiding losses in terminal inventory or concentrating gains in one year or episode.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The filter may miss profitable trends while an old extreme remains in the window and can overtrade when extreme recency changes. One frozen screen either produces a historical candidate for independent OOS or closes the exact family before more threshold or runtime work consumes capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The primary Aroon14 oscillator above zero state improves after-cost risk-adjusted performance versus matched full-capital buy-and-hold in both Design and historical Validation, with stable negative-25 and positive-25 neighbors and broad annual support.
